title: P0.29: Test Governance Observability and ControlMaster Test State
description: IABV has runnable test infrastructure and validation services, but the self-audit/control-master layer does not yet have a reliable live test-state feed that proves which focused/regression suites ran for each runtime fix.
reason: Audit found good executable test mechanisms (pytest command, MCP audit_tools.run_pytest, AutonomousValidationCycleService, ScenarioAutoTestService), but SelfAuditService._build_cross_source_truth currently reports tests_observed=false and ControlMasterState.current_tests_state is not automatically updated from real pytest results.
next_action: Extend existing SelfAuditService/ControlMasterRepository/MCP audit_tools path so every pytest run can persist a compact TestEvidence record: command, suite, passed/failed/errors, duration, changed files, linked pending task, and verification_status. Do not create a new brain or route decider.
resume_hint: Next slice should make test evidence first-class metacognitive input. Keep it read-only/observability-focused: tests inform OSES/PortableContext/ControlMaster; they must not auto-merge or auto-change routes without governance.

observed_working: Official pytest command works in runtime checkout.
MCP audit_tools.run_pytest validates suite/keyword/executable and parses pytest counts.
AutonomousValidationCycleService tracks proposal validation and decision logs.
Focused/runtime regression tests passed after P0.28.
observed_gap: ControlMasterState has current_tests_state but there is no confirmed automatic update from pytest results.
Runtime fixes can pass tests without the organism preserving a compact canonical test evidence record linked to the pending task.
do_not_do: Do not create a new testing brain/service.
Do not make ViewModels decide test strategy.
Do not run heavy full-suite tests during UI startup.
suggested_tests: SelfAuditService reports tests_observed=true when a latest pytest evidence record exists.
ControlMaster latest.md includes compact tests_state after a recorded pytest run.
PortableContext pending/unresolved section references latest failed or missing verification without PII.
audit_tools.run_pytest persists counts only when explicitly requested, not during passive UI startup.
